text:
Bladder washout solution should be sterile, isotonic, and non-irritating—typically normal saline (0.9% NaCl) or sterile water for irrigation—used at body or room temperature without non-intravesical additives. The team note is incorrect: washout fluids should never be made from powdered concentrate mixed with tap water at the bedside, as tap water is not sterile and this practice risks contamination and irritation.
CONFIDENCE: 90
